name: Clip method (VIDEO / faithful handoff) - bty.223 Dc6Dxn5k2Ft + theharis + keeran

parameters.content:
## Source reconstruction (faithful)
Grouped clipping method:
- bty.223/Dc6Dxn5k2Ft: YouTube link -> snazzo.app -> get clips -> post everywhere.
- theharis.ai/DdB5LAZMJmg: paste link -> count, clip length, captions, branding, background music.
- keeran.ai/Db8mEo_x3K1: self-hosted 'Cardio' clipper + subtitles.

## Why this is a HANDOFF, not an HTTP call
snazzo.app / 'my tool' / 'Cardio' have NO verified public API. Inventing an endpoint is forbidden. So this faithful build captures the source URL + theharis settings, emits an explicit operator handoff describing exactly what to do on the named tool, and records returned clip refs for approval-gated posting. The clip generation is PENDING a real contract. See the user-stack variant for a working clipper (OpenShorts).

'Paid per 1000 views' = source claim, not implemented. No auto-posting.
